% Plain LaTeX look for the one-pager: black text, no color.
\usepackage{enumitem}
\setlist{itemsep=1pt,topsep=2pt,parsep=0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{4pt}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\pagestyle{empty}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.2}
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{5pt}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\normalsize\bfseries}{}{0pt}{}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{11pt}{3pt}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand{\maketitle}{{\raggedright\Large\bfseries\@title\par}\vspace{6pt}}
\makeatother
\AtBeginDocument{\fontsize{9.3}{11.2}\selectfont}
